stories.title: Golden Knights can’t close again, lose to Stars in shootout
stories.summary: The Golden Knights blew a third-period lead for the second time in three days, losing to the Dallas Stars in a shootout Thursday at T-Mobile Arena.

stories.title: Police seek help in solving fatal North Las Vegas shooting of teen
stories.summary: The North Las Vegas Police Department is asking for the public’s help in identifying people who may have information about the fatal shooting of a teenager in July.

stories.title: BYRON YORK: What happened to the end of democracy?
COMMENTARY: A hopeful Black candidate helps Mississippi turn blue
stories.summary: Considering its historical significance, Mississippi Sen.-elect Scott Colom’s victory speech sounded like redemption for his home state. I’m just delighted that I lived long enough to see it.
